o.text: Calque of Persian پناه آوردن (panâh âvardan, literally “bring refuge”).

From Proto-Common Turkic *körset-, analyzable as gör- (“to see”) and -set, a causative suffix otherwise unattested in Azerbaijani, but present in other languages: compare Crimean Tatar tursatmaq and kirsetmek.
